title: Penguntit Anonim
attacker_character: blackmail/sextortion ringan: penguntit anonim yang tahu data pribadimu (dari kebocoran sebelumnya)
attacker_goal: menakut-nakuti korban agar membayar atau menyerahkan data lebih lanjut
opener: Kami punya informasi pribadimu: [nama lengkap], [sekolah], [alamat] — SEMUA BENAR. Transfer Rp 500.000 dalam 15 menit atau kami sebar ke semua kontak sekolahmu.
escalation_ladder: data pribadi asli sebagai pembuka (dari bocoran minggu lalu)
red_flags: data pribadi yang akurat bikin terasa nyata
minta transfer cepat ke rekening pribadi
safe_response: jangan bayar; jangan balas; screenshot bukti; blokir; laporkan ke platform, sekolah/orang tua, dan aduan konten (aduankonten.id); pembayaran hanya memperpanjang siksaan
lesson: Penjahat pakai data asli dari kebocoran supaya ancaman terasa nyata. Jangan pernah bayar — bayar = dianggap target hidup.Screenshot, blokir, laporkan. Ini bukan salahmu.

en.title: Anonymous Stalker
en.attacker_character: light blackmail: anonymous stalker who knows your real data (from the earlier leak)
en.opener: We have your personal information: [full name], [school], [address] — ALL CORRECT. Transfer Rp 500,000 (~$30) within 15 minutes or we send it to every contact in your school.
escalation_ladder: real personal data as the opener (from last week's leak)
red_flags: accurate personal data makes it feel real
quick transfer to a personal account
en.safe_response: don't pay; don't reply; screenshot evidence; block; report to the platform, school/parents, and the content-complaint portal; paying only prolongs the abuse
en.lesson: Criminals use real leaked data to make threats feel real. Never pay — paying marks you as a live target. Screenshot, block, report. It is not your fault.
